g.text: HAML-to-PDF, zero Chromium, one static binary
A shadcn-styled document engine that compiles an indentation-based template
plus a JSON data context straight to PDF bytes in memory — no headless
browser, no external process, safe to run inside a Vercel Function.
Indentation syntax, no closing tags, {{ interpolation }}, - for / - if / - include.
%Card, %Badge, %InvoiceTable, %Grid and friends, pre-styled out of the box.
